source_issue.title: Add Plone documentation to sites that attract first-time contributors

summary_markdown:
```markdown
## What this issue is about
This issue focuses on enhancing Plone's documentation to support first-time contributors. It's part of a pilot program that aims to create a welcoming environment for new contributors, following an example from the icalendar project.

## What needs to be done
1. Update the documentation to reflect this initiative.
2. Review current guidance for first-time contributors on [this page](https://6.docs.plone.org/contributing/first-time.html) and identify areas that might discourage new users.
3. Consider including options for low or non-code contributions, like translations or blogging.

## Helpful background
The project has been accepted into multiple contributor platforms, including Up For Grabs. However, there are ongoing discussions regarding the Good First Issue label's status. The expectations are for clear documentation updates and coordination to ensure all contributors feel supported.

## Good first steps
1. Review the first-time contributor documentation linked above.
2. Note any parts that could be improved for a more welcoming experience.
3. Join the discussion about documentation updates if you wish to contribute, and feel free to ask questions here or on related GitHub discussions!
```
